visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a woman with brown hair and bangs wearing a maroon mesh knit sweater. She stands in a bright indoor room with a wooden door behind her, holding a white plastic cosmetic jar and gesturing with her hands while speaking directly to the camera. (2) She leans down and opens a white wooden drawer filled with organized makeup containers. She reaches in to select several items, including a pink packaged puff and a small tube, showing them to the camera while maintaining an expressive facial expression. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up as she begins her skincare routine. She uses a white cotton pad and a cotton swab to meticulously wipe away makeup from her eyes and cheeks, looking into a mirror off-camera. A white hair clip holds her bangs back. (4) She applies a liquid product to a cotton pad and gently taps it across her face. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of her skin as it becomes slightly damp. She then holds a small white handheld fan to her face to dry the product. (5) She picks up a black squeeze tube of sunscreen, dispensing a small amount onto the back of her left hand. She uses her fingers to dot the cream onto her forehead, nose, and cheeks, blending it outward with smooth, rhythmic strokes. (6) A transition shows her holding a silver makeup spatula and a cushion puff. She applies liquid foundation from a glass bottle onto her hand, picks it up with the edge of the spatula, and drags it in thin layers across her cheeks before blending with the puff. (7) She focuses on her under-eye area, using a finger to apply concealer from a silver IPSA palette. She looks intently into a mirror, ensuring even coverage. (8) She holds up a colorful, patterned powder compact and uses a white puff to set her makeup, pressing the powder into her T-zone and cheeks. (9) The woman uses a brush to groom her eyebrows and then applies a light, neutral eyeshadow with a small blending brush. (10) She leans close to the mirror to apply black liquid eyeliner, pulling the skin of her eyelid slightly taut. (11) She applies pink blush to her cheekbones and contour to her jawline using a large fluffy brush, followed by curling her lashes with a silver curler and applying black mascara. (12) The video concludes with her smiling at the camera, showing off the completed 'daily mom' makeup look, with digital heart stickers appearing briefly around her face.

The background music is a bright, mid-tempo pop track featuring rhythmic acoustic guitar and a light electronic beat. (2) A mechanical sliding sound occurs as a drawer is opened, followed by the light rustling of plastic packaging as items are handled. The speaker's voice remains consistently energetic and informative. (3) The soft, percussive sound of a makeup container being clicked open is heard, followed by the faint rustling of cotton pads. The speaker continues her step-by-step narration without pause. (4) A low-frequency whirring sound of a small motor (handheld fan) enters the mix for a few seconds, partially masking the speech. The music continues its steady, upbeat progression in the background. (5) Metallic clinking sounds occur as a makeup spatula is moved against a glass surface. The speaker’s voice adopts a more focused, instructional quality, emphasizing specific techniques for foundation application. (6) A sharp clicking sound of a compact case snapping shut is heard. The music swells slightly in volume during a transition where the voice briefly pauses. (7) Percussive tapping sounds are audible as the speaker applies powder with a puff. The voice continues to provide detailed advice on skin texture and pore coverage.
